detailed_description: The Scatter Chart Generator plots paired values as points on two axes so relationships, clusters, and outliers are easier to see. It is useful when individual observations matter more than totals, such as comparing cost versus return, speed versus load, or price versus rating. You can enter X and Y values, label the points if needed, adjust colors and markers, and export the finished chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Add paired X and Y values in the editor, along with point labels if you want extra context.
Set the chart title and confirm the axes match the comparison you want to show.
Adjust colors, marker size, labels, and legend visibility to keep the plot readable.
Review the preview and refine the data or labels where important points overlap.
Export the completed scatter chart as PNG or SVG once the relationship is easy to interpret.
usage_examples: Compare ad spend and conversion rate by campaign to spot efficient outliers.
Plot request volume against response time to see where systems begin to slow down.
Visualize price and rating data to compare products in a catalog or marketplace.
